maddeler.e:
أمتدح (form VIII)
# أَمْتَدِحُ (ʔamtadiḥu) /ʔam.ta.di.ħu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِمْتَدَحَ (imtadaḥa)
# أُمْتَدَحُ (ʔumtadaḥu) /ʔum.ta.da.ħu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَدَحَ (imtadaḥa)
# أَمْتَدِحَ (ʔamtadiḥa) /ʔam.ta.di.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِمْتَدَحَ (imtadaḥa)
# أُمْتَدَحَ (ʔumtadaḥa) /ʔum.ta.da
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
